<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Adds a row to one of your datasets for each item: the fields chosen, or the whole item, with when (_at), the workflow (_workflow), its run (_execution) and whether it trades on paper or live (_mode). Items pass on unchanged.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `data.record` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead. What fails is tried again only when **Retry** asks.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dataset (`dataset`) | dataset | yes |  | The dataset the rows go to: one of yours, or a new one. Personal: sharing the workflow leaves it out. |
| Fields (`fields`) | list of text | no |  | The fields recorded, like city or outcomes.0.price, each under its name as written; none for the whole item. Each names a field of the items it receives; saving checks the items have it. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
